items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:1:1
items.html: To revive the dead: These are the seven first kings that fell to BYA of separation, which fall is considered death, since there they are separated from the light of life, which means the light of Hochma, in the secret of the verse, “and the wisdom shall revive its owner,” for the light of Hochma is indeed called the light of Haya, as is known. Therefore the three worlds BYA are called the worlds of separation, because in these places the light of Hochma cannot expand, and all the reality in them dies and not in wisdom, and there is no remedy for them except by their ascent to Atzilut, that is, to the place where Hochma is found to expand in them. Therefore, when they rise to the world of Atzilut, they are regarded as having risen to life, having merited the light of Haya. And this is what he says: “When it arose in the will of the Emanator to revive the dead” — that is, to raise them from BYA to Atzilut, and this is the secret of the revival of the dead, and this is the secret of the correction of the seven kings, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:1:2
items.html: He decreed and raised MAN from below upward: That is, from the place of ZON up to Keter. The matter of the ascent of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] has already been well explained on page 501, the passage beginning “The degree,” and from there you should seek it. But here one must understand an additional essential matter: that these MAN are the seven lights that remained from the seven kings, that is, the records that the lights of ZAT left behind after they departed, as the ARI writes below. For after the screen of Nekudim was refined entirely of all the coarseness of the Guf [body] in it, it returned and rose to its root in the Rosh [head] of Nekudim, together with all the records included in it, as is known. And since it had already come there in phase one, in the coupling of the Daat of Nekudim, as above in the Inner Light (page 543, the passage beginning “And when”), it turns out that its last phase is phase one. Therefore the screen thickened by force of its inclusion in the Rosh only in the measure of the coarseness of Keter, since the last phase is lost, and it turns out that no level could come out upon it other than the level of Malchut, as is known. It is therefore regarded that the bottom Hey included in the screen rose from the Einayim to Keter, and the coupling was made in the Sefira of Keter. Thus it turns out that the aforementioned ascent of MAN is to the place of Keter.
